reason: The hypothesis transfers the disorder-independent DOS-driven Tc modulation mechanism, previously suggested for (TaNb)1-x(HfZrTi)x films (P30), to a new Ti-rich bcc HEA composition space (e.g., Nb-Ti-Zr-Hf-Mo) and proposes a specific V-for-Mo substitution to test it, which is not proposed or studied in any passage. The combination of the Ti-rich matrix, the explicit electron-count tuning via V substitution, and the quantitative Tc-DOS correlation prediction goes beyond the existing literature.
